C-001.reasoning: Sec. 2.2 and 3.1 establish securities account control under UCC 8-106(d)(2).

C-003.reasoning: Sec. 2.3 and 3.2 establish 9-104(a)(2) deposit account control, complying with Indenture Trustee instructions without Issuer consent.

C-004.reasoning: The preamble, Sec. 2.2/2.3 and 8.1(d)-(e) state Sovereign acts as both securities intermediary and bank.

C-005.reasoning: Memo item 1 identifies dual characterization as a departure and explains that uninvested cash needs 9-104 control.

C-006.reasoning: Sec. 7.1 expressly waives setoff, recoupment, banker's lien and similar rights against all Accounts.

C-007.reasoning: Sec. 7.1 states it is a waiver and extinguishment, not merely a subordination.

C-008.reasoning: Sec. 7.1 states the standard-form fee lien is not part of the Agreement and prohibits debiting Accounts for fees.

C-009.reasoning: Memo item 2 identifies deletion of the fee lien and the addition of the absolute waiver as a material departure.

C-010.reasoning: Memo cites Clearwater pre-sale III.D requiring an absolute waiver and discusses Indenture 3.01(e) (Flag A).

C-012.reasoning: Sec. 5.1 lets the Indenture Trustee deliver an ECN upon an Event of Default.

C-013.reasoning: Sec. 5.1 and Schedule B specify written delivery, by email PDF or courier, to a named contact.

C-014.reasoning: Sec. 5.2 requires Sovereign to cease immediately complying with anyone other than the Indenture Trustee, including the Servicer.

C-015.reasoning: Sec. 5.3(b) bars Servicer Fee withdrawals after an ECN except on Indenture Trustee instruction.

C-016.reasoning: Sec. 2.4(a) elects New York by express agreement under 8-110(e)(1), acknowledging the Boston chief executive office.

C-017.reasoning: Memo item 4 discusses the New York designation against the Boston chief executive office and explains the deliberate 8-110(e) election.

C-021.reasoning: Sec. 6.4 requires transfer to the Distribution Account only.

C-022.reasoning: Sec. 12.1 makes resignation ineffective until a Qualified Institution successor is appointed and has executed the documentation.

C-023.reasoning: Sec. 12.2 requires Sovereign to continue serving until the Succession Conditions are satisfied.

C-024.reasoning: Memo item 5 identifies the change to the 30-day resignation provision and ties it to the Qualified Institution and successor requirement.

C-025.reasoning: Sec. 4.4(a) requires earnings and proceeds to be credited to the originating Account.

C-026.reasoning: Sec. 4.4(a) expressly prohibits commingling earnings with any other Account.

C-027.reasoning: Sec. 15.2 requires 10 Business Days' prior written notice to Clearwater, including for adverse amendments.

C-028.reasoning: Memo item 9 and Flag D identify the notice requirement as an addition and tie it to Clearwater pre-sale IV and Indenture 10.16.

C-029.reasoning: Sec. 11.3 raises the cap to the greater of 12 months of fees and $15M, with carve-outs for gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and the setoff waiver.

C-030.reasoning: Memo item 7 identifies the $45,000 cap (0.0117% of $385M) as a departure, explains why it is inadequate, and modifies it.

C-034.reasoning: Sec. 4.1(b) gives the Indenture Trustee sole investment authority after an ECN.
